name: Lu4 Wiki: NPC Enchanted Forest Watcher Ruell

links.name: Raid Boss Lv. 1 If the person who made the greatest contribution is 3 or more Lv.s higher than the raid monster, then the item/Adena rewards will decrease. If the difference is 9 or more Lv.s, the monster will drop nothing at all.

Raid Boss Lv. 1 Treant Guardian who watches over the outer area of Fairy Forest under the command of Queen Timidiel. It hates intruders who disrupt the order of the forest, and it cannot forgive anyone who breaks the laws of the forest. With the power received from Queen Timidiel, it calls Sylph and Unicorn, and it protects Fairy Forest together with them.
Spirits Lv. 7 Takes 15% increased damage from attacks that are effective against Spirits. P. Def. +5% Evasion +5 Resistance to Derangement +20% Resistance to Sleep +20% M. Def. -5% Accuracy -5
